تصككن (form I)
# تَصْكُكْنَ (taṣkukna) /tasˤ.kuk.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of صَكَّ (ṣakka)
# تُصْكَكْنَ (tuṣkakna) /tusˤ.kak.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of صَكَّ (ṣakka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
